jp:
「{bb}かぐや姫さま{ww}が　さらわれた時から
　竹林の　中から　光りが　見えるように
　なったの……」{KP}
　
「何かしら……？」
en: "Ever since {bb}Princess Kaguya-sama{ww} was kidnapped, a light has been showing in the bamboo grove..."{KP}"I wonder what it is...?"

jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　かぐや姫さまを　助けて
　いただいたそうですね！」{KP}
　
「ありがとうございました！」
en: "Momotaro-san! I hear you rescued Princess Kaguya-sama!"{KP}"Thank you so much!"

"Momotaro-san, this is a secret I can't tell outside, but"{KP}"they say if you take lots of {bb}Dialect Cards{ww} to the {bb}Card Hermit{ww}, you'll get a prize!"{KP}"The number of {bb}Dialect Cards{ww} for a prize is 10, 30..."{KP}"Hmm, I've gone and forgotten the rest!"
